premises.text: Email is the dominant smartphone activity, taking about 40% of phone time
premises.evidence_span: People spend 40% of their time on smartphone to deal with the emails

premises.text: Conventional mobile email forces users through formats, metadata, and signatures
premises.evidence_span: frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures again and again

premises.text: MailTime reformats email into a text-message-like conversation view
premises.evidence_span: reformat all your emails into this conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging

premises.text: Task assignment via @mentions and a to-do-style task manager are built into the mail client
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime can also help you manage your tasks like a to-do list

premises.text: The product nudges short emails so recipients will read them
premises.evidence_span: keep your emails short, short enough so that people can actually read them

premises.text: Mail is exchanged directly with the user's mail server; cloud is used only for change listening and push
premises.evidence_span: send and receive every single email just directly between your mail server and Mailtime on your phone

premises.text: Monetization is freemium on connected email accounts at $0.99 beyond the first
premises.evidence_span: Mailtime will be free to connect with first email account. We will charge you only $0.99 if you want to connect more email account with Mailtime

value.text: Email for smartphones that people can read and act on quickly
value.evidence_span: MailTime. It's a way how we design email for your smartphone

causal_links.evidence_span: frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures
conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging
free to connect with first email account
